I will plant maize the way I can afford on this small plot, and I will not do anything too expensive. If I get fertilizer in time, I will use one bag shared across my field area, because on 0.37 hectares I cannot manage much more cash than that, and I have seen other farmers do the same. I will use improved seed if I can buy it, because it usually does better when the rains are okay, and I will also put some manure if I have enough from home. I do not irrigate here, and I will mostly use family labor, with only a few hired days if we are late for weeding.
